nom: EltaMD UV AOX Elements Tinted Mineral Face Sunscreen Lotion

avis.titre: Sensitive, Redness-Prone Skin? This Is the Routine That Finally Worked for MeSensitive, Redness-Prone Skin? This Is the
avis.texte: I've used EltaMD products for 15+ years, but I’ve struggled ever since they changed the formula of their tinted sunscreen—the new UV AOX Elements casts an orange hue on my fair, somewhat freckled skin (Type II) with rosacea. After a long trial-and-error journey (and a lot of frustration), I finally found a routine that works—and I think others with sensitive or redness-prone skin should know about it. What finally worked: EltaMD UV Skin Recovery (green-tinted) 50 SPF Red Color Correcting Sunscreen This was a dermatologist recommendation, and it’s been a game-changer. Don’t be alarmed by the green color—it fades within seconds of application and immediately counteracts redness. Over 6+ weeks, it’s also reduced my inflammation and improved my skin’s texture and tone. It’s lightweight, moisturizing, not greasy, and doesn’t irritate my rosacea or trigger breakouts. I use it as a moisturizer and as a base layer before applying tinted sunscreen. I hope Amazon will start selling it soon! CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 (Sheer Tinted) This blends beautifully and has zero orange cast. It layers over the green EltaMD UV Skin Recovery perfectly with no clumping or pilling. No smell, no transfer, and it gives a smooth, sheer tint that has buildable coverage. I use this as my primary tinted SPF. EltaMD UV AOX Elements (Tinted) I still use this—but now as a light bronzer. I layer a small amount under or over the CeraVe for a touch of warmth without letting the orange tone take ov

avis.titre: FULL SPECTRUM PROTECTION WITH THE LIGHTEST OF TEXTURES.
avis.texte: I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen. The texture is very light and silky, barely there . I adore the tinted one , it's like a delicate moisturising foundation and leaves a lovely glow on the skin yet with the benefit of the BROAD SPECTRUM protection UVA, UVB. Being so light it can be used under make up if desired or on its own . I live in the tropics, have fair skin sensitive to the sun and have used the best high protection factor full spectrum sun screen all my life, but none as light as EltaMD. I have been using it for 3 years now (and recently heard that Elta MD Full Spectrum sunscreen is a favorite of top cosmetic surgeon Dr Amir Karam).

avis.titre: Impressive and good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is the 3rd sunscreen formulation I've tried from Elta MD, and just like the others I'm impressed. Background: I am a male with sensitive, oily and rosacea prone skin. I've been loving the Elta Recovery (white and green tinted versions) but wanted a tinted SPF for the days where I need some extra coverage. This is great - it provides a subtle tint that covers and masks skin imperfections like a light foundation. The finish is not pure matte, but it's not glossy or dewy by any means. It's right in the middle, and it stays put. This one is also water resistant, which is a big plus. If I'm planning on being in the sun for a while, I'll use a thicker amount. I've found it helpful to mix this with a bit of the non-tinted mineral Recovery SPF, also by Elta, to tone down the intensity of the tint. I have very fair skin, so that is a good tip if you use a thick layer. Keep it coming, Elta! These formulations are great!

This is my everyday sunscreen! I’m prone to melasma and dark spots, so my dermatologist recommended wearing sunscreen every day, preferably SPF 50 or higher. I love that this one is tinted, which gives me light coverage and works almost like a foundation, so I don’t need to apply an additional foundation when I’m in a hurry. It’s also not too oily, and I simply finish with a little loose powder to set it. It feels comfortable, provides the coverage I want, and is easy to incorporate into my daily routine. Highly recommended!

Superb coverage with a very small amount. I had no allergic reaction and it does not turn orange once on the skin. I love this product as I am a hiker with very sensitive skin. It is my new makeup where I could never wear any before! Awesome product.

I had tried a much cheaper tinted moisturizer with spf. I didn't like it so I finally broke down and purchased this. I love it. The tint is perfect for my fair skin. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or looking shiny. It's my new daily face product.
Working fine so far Not greasy But not very tinted on the skin But has a great feel

avis.titre: Melts into face. Very good for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen, I use medication on my face and it doesn't burn. I melts into my face color for the most part just slightly lighter. I'm surprised it goes on like you would expect out of regular mineral sunscreen then after a couple minutes blends beautifully. It does for me the same thing foundation would do. It gives off a nice glow.

Non dó 5 stelle perché l’inserzione riportava la dicitura fps 50, invece è 44. Comunque un ottimo prodotto, si stende molto bene sul viso e la colorazione si adegua anche ad incarnati molto chiari come il mio
Love this sunscreen so much it’s almost like a tinted moisturiser but very light and dewy on the skin.
ممتاز كتغطية و مايحسس ويرطب وجميل مرة ع البشرة لان فيه لون خفيف. لكن ماانصح فيه للبشرة الدهنية بفترة الصيف تحديداً لانه شويه يعتبر ثقيل

avis.titre: Muy satisfecha con el protector solar
avis.texte: Estoy muy satisfecha con este protector solar. Tiene óxido de zinc y me gusta mucho la textura. Además, el tono con color es bonito, aunque a veces lo mezclo con otro protector mineral para que quede un poco más claro. Lo recomiendo.

An excellent 2-in-1 moisturizer and sunscreen for mature skin. It simplifies my morning routine by replacing a light foundation, protecting against stubborn pigmentation, and delivering the deep hydration my skin needs. Keeps me protected from the sunny beach all day.
Amo este bloqueador solar, tengo piel mixta un poco deshidratada y es hermoso como deja la piel
Love that this has a tint to it, my favorite sunscreen. The tint makes I look like you are wearing makeup! It’s light and doesn’t feel heavy on your face!
Me sorprendió lo bueno que salió. Funciona perfecto, el material se siente bien y no tuve ningún problema con el envío. Lo recomiendo

I have been researching sunscreen and this brand tops several “most recommended” lists. The mineral active ingredients are recommended by our dermatologist and I like the addition of the hyaluronic acid and Vit. C derivative. Mineral sunscreen has a tendency to leave a white film so I opted for the tinted - although I don’t think it’s an issue with this brand. It was a perfect color and blended so nice and sheer. Not oily at all! This does have a form of silicone in it, so that could be an issue with water-based makeup, but, I didn’t have any problems wearing it under my foundation and cream (water-based) bronzer. The higher number spf is great too! It also ranks ok with the EWG (Environmental Working Group) as far as how well it blocks the uva/uvb rays.

I have used this sunscreen before in a squeeze tube. I prefer that to this ridiculous pump. After 15 pumps and nothing, I took the top off and found this itty, bitty pump stem. I wasted product as I tried to get the pump to work correctly. The high cost of this product should include a user friendly delivery system. The product itself is excellent for my skin. I do put a bit of light moisturizer on prior to applying. I am discouraged by the inadaquency of the pump mechanism. Not sure if I will purchase again.

El bloqueado solar con tono es una maravilla , parece pastoso pero una vez q te lo pones la piel lo traga, te cubre super bien . Excelente producto lo tengo en mis suscripciones . Es para piel madura preferiblemente

avis.titre: Review of New Formula - UV AOX Elements 50 vs UV Elements 44
avis.texte: DON’T LET THE PRODUCT PHOTO FOOL YOU — I guess it hasn’t been updated? The photo shown is the original formula UV Elements 44, but this page is to buy the new formula (EltaMD has reformulated this product) UV AOX Elements 50. This is a review of the new formulation, UV AOX Elements 50 spf where I compare it with the original UV Elements 44 spf (and respond to recent reviews I’ve been reading and how they match up with my experience) I’ll start with what I like. I really like that it’s 50 spf. What’s up with these random spf numbers from Eltamd? — 44, 41, 46. I always try to wear 50 because my face is very susceptible to burning and I use tretinoin or other retinoids. I really did love the original Elements 44 spf, but I do like that the new one is 50. HOWEVER, I know they had to add some ingredients to bulk up the spf, and that means the new formula is not a purely physical sunscreen (mainly, they added Butyloctyl Salicylate, which is a chemical UV filter). I know this matters to a lot of people. I know a lot of people can be sensitive to it. So I get the negative reviews. For me I don’t love that it’s in there, but I also don’t totally mind. I’m fortunate enough to where I’m not sensitive to it. On to the shade of the tint. Reviews on here are saying it’s more orange. I don’t see that personally. I still have a tube of the Elements 44 and I took a picture here comparing them side by side on the back of my hand. The top is the Elements 44. The bottom is AOX 50. They really lo

My dermatologist recommended this sunscreen to add into my skin care routine of tretinoin and clindamycin phosphate, I washed my face ,added the climdamycin, a thin layer of my moisturizer because I have dry skin, and then lastly added this sunscreen. I was so excited to try it because I thought it was gonna work out great, but immediately after applying my face felt so extremely tight. I looked in the mirror and it’s making any acne marks that are healing look super dry, it’s highlighting some scabbing I have and it doesn’t look glowy at all on my skin. It’s been an hour since application and my skin still feels tight. Maybe this would work out Great for someone with oily skin but it didn’t work out for me😢😢😢SO SAD! Back to my sunscreen quest. Also paid 40$ which is a lot just for it to not work. About to get that refund yall. TINT isn’t bad though as you can see in the pictures it doesn’t look orange or anything and I have rather fair complexion. ALSO IT SMELLS SO BAD! Put it on and every time I went outside I got this terrible wiff of dank sunscreen. Smelt so bad wanted to take it off immediately. Sunscreen smell was so bad throughout the day.

Filipina girl here with brown skin. Skin type: oily I LOVE this sunscreen! It has a medium-thick consistency. It blends perfectly into my skin, dries down quick, and doesn’t leave me greasy. A few hours later, I’m not looking oily. It somehow also helps keep my oils under control. Definitely going to repurchase!

This has become my daily makeup! I can’t believe how soft and smooth my face feels after washing this off, and I get compliments on how I look with it on. I’ve never been a makeup person but now I have something even better.

avis.titre: Don’t waste your money not the same
avis.texte: Damn I wrote a really good long detailed review. Here’s the short version. Shame on you elta md. My photo is awful bc I stopped using the “same new one” for a week and scraping out the rest of the actual uv elements spf 44 tinted for a week and my breakouts improved. This was the culprit. It is not the same it is thicker and greasy and frankly sucks. Not cool guys I’d request a refund or a replacement., but it’s past that lovely date Amazon screws you with when you simply plan ahead like myself.! My sister is a dermatologist and is complaining to their rep and seeing if they have any of the old stuff left to get for me. Don’t buy this. Save your skin time and money. Uv clear is okay but not as much coverage. But I only tried it once and ordered on accident. 2 years of using this thanks for jacking up my skin again and discontinuing the perfect product. Be warned if you tried cerave tinted mineral sunscreen and it made you break out, this is worse.

I have always loved this product. It looks nice on my skin and I don't get burned and it is really all I use for makeup. Unfortunately, I deal with cystic acne and this seems to trigger it for me so I'm going to have to find another sunscreen. I know everyone talks about how great this brand is and dermatologists have recommended it to me, but my skin doesn't love it . After taking a few months break from it (with limited to no breakouts), one week into using it and I have 3 cystic pimples starting in the same area in my chin.

I ordered my second package of this so I would have on hand as I think the product is great on my skin. I finally started using this second bottle a month after I bought it. A month later, the product started to come out at base of the pump. The 30 day amazon return period was over so I reached out to Elta directly. They apologized but said there is nothing they could do. So I now have a messy bottle and am losing product. Will look for another similar product.

I have been using Elta MD UV Replenish broad spectrum SPF 44 tinted sunscreen for 8 years. It is all I wear as my “foundation” for makeup. I’m very fair and it’s perfect for me. I went to order a new tube and they’ve changed their formula to a 50 spf that’s more expensive for LESS product.They been increasing their prices since the pandemic, capitalizing on the economy by passing an over $10 price increase per tube onto their consumers. Even though I don’t appreciate that, as a loyal customer I figured it was easier to stick with what I know because I’ve been a customer so long. I tried the 50 spf today, MY FACE IS ORANGE! I am so disappointed and dissatisfied. I went to their website HOPING they are still selling the original formula and they aren’t. Now I must begin the search for a new tinted sunscreen after 8 years. Colorscience is the only one I’m familiar with but haven’t tried it either. Sometimes it’s better to leave things alone that are working. They’ve lost a loyal customer.

It is a good option for people who want to add a touch of color to the skin because it is almost non-covering, dries and does not transfer at all. As for sun protection, I do not consider it to be good depending on how it reflects in blue light, but the experts will decide that. I do not recommend it if you are looking for good coverage.

avis.titre: I will always love this product
avis.texte: This sunscreen is really my personal choice. It blends well with my skin after application just like a foundation it covers my hyper pigmentation making it less visible. I will repurchase again and again and again…..

I love this product, second time ordering. This product doesn’t settle into wrinkles & fine lines, that’s my favorite part. It stays on all day and doesn’t ever look blotchy. The pictures are right after applying. I use concealer too under my eyes and then my skin is done! I recommend this product to everyone and will never go back to regular foundation. If you’re wondering if you should try this product, definitely do!!!

My FAVORITE facial sunscreen!!! It goes on smooth leaving skin feeling hydrated, and with no white residue left on skin! It is tinted so it gives a light coverage. I personally do not think it’s a sunscreen to be used sunbathing for hours. It is great for everyday wear, running errands with some sun exposure. LOVE it!

avis.titre: Buyer Beware! Unhealthy Inactive Ingredients are hidden from the website.
avis.texte: Based on the advertising, I thought I was getting an all-natural product free of toxic chemicals. You'll notice they mention non-toxic "Active ingredients" but never speak to or even show you a listing of their Inactive ingredients. I tried the product and it immediately irritated my face. I looked at the box and found a hidden list of "Inactive ingredients" such as Dimethicone, which I have an allergy to. Another chemical on the Inactive ingredient listing is Cyclopentasiloxane, a known hormone disruptor associated with environmental toxicity. The European Consumer Organization considers Cyclopentasiloxane in skin care so toxic, the European Chemicals Agency proposed a restriction for the use of it in leave-on cosmetics. Alumina is another Inactive ingredient listed, which is a form of Aluminum, another harmful ingredient. These just happen to be the toxic ingredients I'm knowledgeable about. There may even be more if someone has time to do the digging. I'm just angry I was duped by the marketing efforts put forth by this company!

First tube seemed great. The second one gave me trouble. The tint seemed to turn my face an orange color after a bit and the pump didn’t work well. The product always came out around the base of the pump making a huge mess. I ordered it a third time because I was hopeful my second tubs was just bad, and while the pump works, the color seems more orange again once it sits on my face. I really love the product if not for those issues. I may try the untinted version and use a different brands tinted moisturizer to even out my skin tone. It never made my face feel dry or breakout!

avis.titre: Too dark for very fair skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen!! It’s smooth and looks great under makeup or alone. Would have given it 5 stars except its too dark for my fair skin. Exchanging for no tint.

Love the product itself but the last time I ordered I couldn’t figure out why product would not come out after a zillion pumps, then opened the top and discovered it was severed. Past time frame for return. Already disposed prior one so can’t use that pump. Bummer. So heads up on this.

avis.titre: Best tinted sunscreen on the market
avis.texte: Hands down the best sunscreen I’ve ever used. So moisturizing. I am a collector of tinted sunscreens and I always come back to this one. It provides just enough coverage to make it look like I’m wearing no makeup, yet covers small imperfections in the skin. This pic is no makeup. Only the sunscreen

This is not EltaMD UV Elements Tinted Sunscreen Moisturizer, which was my favorite and the only facial sunscreen I used. I also told many friends about it, and they loved it too. The company stopped making EltaMD UV Elements Tinted Sunscreen Moisturizer, and this is the replacement : UVAOX Elements Tinted Sunscreen. It is thick and sticky when applied, and is a slightly darker, more yellow color. It is also 1.7 oz; whereas the one it replaces was 2.0 oz. I came here to buy out what was remaining of the original, which was a good color, moisturizing, and applied smoothly. Unfortunately, only this new product is available. I will be looking elsewhere to find a replacement for what was my favorite. Disappointing!

Used this 2 days in a row (Sat & Sun). Monday woke up to swollen/itchy face. Didn’t use again. Benadryl didn’t take care of the problem. Prednisone day 4. Still dealing with a terrible reaction to this product. Dr said probably the zinc oxide caused the reaction.

I love this cream, it’s so smooth and gives great color, coverage and sun protection but…like other customers have pointed out, the major flaw is in the packaging where the pump stops distributing halfway through and there’s still tons to use. Definitely needs to be addressed by the manufacturer!

avis.titre: tint is pretty dark not a good pic for a person with fair complexion
avis.texte: I guess I missed the return time. I ordered Elta MD 44 tinted because I liked the Elta product 30 uv facial . I did want a little more uv protection and a bit of tinting. Unfortunately this product was way to dark and even when I mixed it with non tinted the color didn't really lighten up. too darn dark . They should come up with parameters of tint color. the zinc in this one is 10% compared to 7% of the 30 uv. I have to tell you the 30 goes on very smoothly. Im sorry I cant tell you how smoothly this one goes on due to the tint.

Sunscreen is GREAT. Not chalky or greasy, wears well under make up. Dispenser is HORRIBLE. I wasted SO MUCH product because I had to wipe it off. Decided to just open lid each time, which is a quick fix, but dispenser issues will keep me from repurchasing.

avis.titre: Ruined a good product with the “upgraded” formula
avis.texte: I have repurchased the UV Elements SPF 44 in the tube numerous times. The new formula in the pump bottle claims to be the same, “upgraded” formula but it’s just awful. It is heavier, more oily and several shades darker than the original formula. It looks completely orange on my face. Not to mention, the new packaging is not an upgrade. You can’t tell when you’re running low like you could with the tube. Running empty won’t be a problem with the new formula though since it’s so orange it’s unusable. Why would the brand chose to change a formula on a cult-favorite product? Makes no sense.

THIS REVIEW IS FOR JULY 2024: Please bring back the old formula, this new formula is THICK AND GOOPY. It’s unusable for mature, dry skin. I had the old formula for years and it went on smooth like butter and created a beautiful moisturizing slightly glowy finish. This is matte and thick and settles into every wrinkle. I was on a subscription with the old formula and without telling me they sent the new one. Not happy and cancelled subscription. See photos. Old formula on the left VS new formula on the right.

It contains CANOLA OIL. Not acne safe at all, there's so many other oils for cosmetics like squalane that are acne safe I don't know why they chose canola, an oil we use to cook. The old formula was oil free and when scanned in my skin safe app was 100% safe, this one is not. Elta MD was bought out by Colgate corp. so when I reordered the sunscreen I've been using since 2020, I knew the quality would possibly go downhill, I should have looked at the ingredients on here before ordering. I'll be returning and looking for a new tinted mineral sunscreen.

Like everything about it - except that i received an obviously USED tube! The packaging is torn, makeup marks on the inside of lid, the actual dispenser as well as the exterior of the tube, GROSS. I won't be reordering from this distributor .

avis.titre: Got extremely sunburnt using this product
avis.texte: I’m so upset. I used this as sunscreen on my face, neck and ears at the beach. The SPF30 Target brand kept the rest of my skin protected and my face and neck got SO burnt even though I reapplied and use this exactly as directed.
I think it matched my skin tone very well and spreed out very well. I like it I’m glad I got it
LOVE THIS! 1) All you need for your face in one! 2) NATURAL subtle looking coverage and glow I just use with a little bit of bronzer
The product itself is great. It moisturizes my skin well hit the packaging is horrible. The seam leaks every time I use it wasting a lot of product.

Please buyer beware; advertised as SPF 50 (sticker on side of box states this), however received SPF 40. Love this product, however will be returning & purchase from my dermatologist for better accuracy.
Literal trash. Burned my face off. I didn’t realize they reformulated from the now discontinued Elements spf 44. I hate that they merged reviews because this product deserves negative stars.
Worst sunscreen I’ve ever used!!! My eyes swelled shut and rashes broke out all over my neck and face.

I waited for a few months to open this product because I was finishing another like it. When I opened it it would not pump and I discovered there was no tube inside or it was broken and down inside the make up. I don’t see an easy way to return this at this late. I hope someone from the company will contact me about arranging a late return because of the circumstances.
The changed the formula of this amazing product. It was light with color. Now it is for darker, strong, it’s not light and the tint ruined a white blouse. Be careful!

Makes my face look greasy. Doesn't dry quickly and feels oily when in fact it states its oil free...go figure. Here's a picture of my fingers after I rubbed the sunscreen on my face. You can see its shiny, not matte at all.

I received the product timely, however when I opened the package I realized that the product was used. It looks like the top of the pump was wiped off and shipped to me - and it’s being returned because I paid for what I believed to be a brand new product.
i saw a lot of reviews saying how great this was but when it arrived i scanned with the Yuka app and this showed up so.. im definitely gonna return this

avis.titre: Terrible breakout!! Read the bad reviews!!!!
avis.texte: So I LOVED this sunscreen until my recent reorder. I thought I was getting the same product when I hit reorder but when it showed up the SPF was higher and the packaging was different. Figured I was getting an even better version of what I loved with an updated look. Boy was I wrong. Whatever changed in the formula sent my skin into an absolute tailspin. I’m on day 4 of a rash that covers my entire face, neck, chest, ears, and back of my neck that top of my shoulders. It is clear where the sunscreen was because that’s where I have puss filled whelps, and the rash spread beyond that area but isn’t as severe where I didn’t have the sunscreen. I’m having to take prescription steroids for the first time in my life & put on antibiotic gel twice a day. I live in Texas and I work outdoors. My livelihood is dependent on working in the sun and currently I can’t let the sun touch my skin, and if I get warm or close to sweating my skin gets worse. I literally look like a swamp creature and am beyond uncomfortable. I rarely leave reviews but whoever’s idea it was to exchange these products as equals should know they really messed up my skin. Beware of what you order and if you get a “new version” or different packaging make sure you check the ingredient percentages before using it. I guess I shouldn’t be so trusting. Truly disappointed. Wish I had read the bad reviews before reordering. SO MANY PEOPLE have had this problem! Ugh!

For the price point, the pump should work. Product instead is pushed out the sides, wasted and makes a huge mess. I have to press the pump 20-30 time to get a pea sized amount product out to apply to my face. Ditch the pump and charge customers less for this.
I love this tinted moisturizer but the bottle it came in is defective. The product comes out the sides instead of the top. Very messy.
How is it possible that I've only used these items a few times and they're already gone? This bottle is empty; what a rip-off!
If you have sensitive skin you probably don't want to use this product. After only two days of using it I'm left with breakouts and a bad reaction.

avis.titre: Pump doesn’t work - do not buy this!
avis.texte: The pump doesn’t work. It’s really annoying. Even moreso because I was finishing up my previous bottle and the return period passed. Ugh
I didn’t not use it and how I suppose to return leaking bottle
Beware. The top of the product was missing and there was literally nothing inside, just an empty container.
Buyer beware. This is literally how it arrived. No mess. No anything. Just an empty container.
Love this product but the pump stopped working with at least 1/2 left in the tube! How can I buy that again?

avis.titre: Too yellow, too dark and doesn’t play well with others
avis.texte: This sunscreen is patchy over a simple moisturizer even after a dry down period. It can’t be used with other products underneath (think serums, creams, antioxidants). It’s way too dark and very yellow. The sunscreen feels good on application, but looks terrible.

I normally don’t write a lot of reviews, but wanted to do so for this sunscreen because 1) I relied on the reviews before purchasing this and 2) hope my review helps someone else decide whether to buy this or not. I do love the sunscreen because the tint is pretty sheer, but it also provides enough coverage to smooth out the blemishes on my face. It does not look like I’m wearing make up at all. I think it blends well with my Asian color tones. I also have acne prone skin, and so far have not noticed any breakouts with this sunscreen. Because of the price point, I will probably use this when I’m going out or if I expect to run into people :) I might try to find some thing less expensive for my other days (for running errands).

This product has been reformulated and is now 1.7 oz vs 2 oz. Like that the spf is now 50 but the texture is different. Do NOT love that they decreased the volume but upped the price. Strong side eye Elta MD. Shrinkflation in the US is out of control!

avis.titre: Easy to blend and good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is my favorite tinted mineral sunscreen so far. I've tried the Colorscience (Flex, Medium) before, but that one is too dark for my complexion. This one's just right. My problem with this is that it gets cakey when I reapply. So, I am hoping to find a new one. Unfortunately, since I have eczema, my skin reacts to chemical sunscreen. I've already tried the Japanese and Korean ones. I love their formula, my skin does not. Another thing I don't like about the product is the price just keeps going up! It's crazy!

avis.titre: BEST SUNSCREEN I HAVE EVER USED
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this product. I have tried a few elta MD sunscreens as well as many brands of face sunscreens. What I love most about this product is how it smooths my skin when I wear it. It makes my skin look like I have just a little bit of beautiful tinted moisturizer on. I went to a wedding once and forgot my make up and used this sunscreen and it worked perfectly! What I love most is how water resistant it is. I work out in this all the time and ride my bike and go to brunch and I feel like my face still looks smooth and is protected. I also try to keep my face out of the sun and this product makes my face look as tan as my body which I love. I am scraping what’s left out of my current bottle and ordering my second one now !
I wish the tone is lighter. It is too dark for my skin tone. I like the texture and that the container is push pump type.

Sheer coverage, super easy application, love how it gives me a quick pick up when I’m being too lazy…. This is all I used for work today… mascara, lipstick and this great moisturizer. It will not cover blemishes or dark spots but it does a great job even it out redness while giving the sun protection! Love it. No filter, too busy for the full make up this morning !

I honesty hate this updated formula. I can’t seem to find the correct sunscreen that i purchased before (UV ELEMENTS spf 44) I loved that sunscreen, it was the right undertone, it blended so well, and it felt good on my skin. If I’m paying close to $50 for a sunscreen it better be good. The undertones are different. This one is much more orangey. I tried showing on the swatch on my hand with different lighting. And it doesn’t blend nicely, i have to blend it so hard and for so long, sometimes i see an orange streak on my face.
